title: Canary Sweep Controller with A/B Traffic Calibration and Auto-attenuation
author: Marta Ruiz
ci_status: pass (flaky integration failed on first run; rerun fixed)
description: Motivation: Our current staged canary controller requires manual per-cohort tuning to hit statistical power and latency budgets for A/B experiments. This PR implements a Canary Sweep Controller that runs short, automated micro-experiments (sweeps) across traffic fractions to calibrate the optimal lift point for promotion or automatic rollback. The controller integrates with the rollout runtime, telemetry, and evaluation hooks to make closed-loop decisions while respecting latency SLOs and cost constraints. Design summary: 1) Sweep jobs: short-lived parallel trials at configured traffic fractions (e.g., 1%, 5%, 10%) with bootstrapped significance checks. 2) Calibration layer: computes an effect size estimate and traffic at which power >= configured threshold while staying within latency tail constraints. 3) Auto-attenuation: if sweep signals degraded latency or regression beyond thresholds, the controller reduces traffic and triggers snapshot rollback hooks. 4) A/B aware routing: integrates with the traffic router to allocate traffic slices for A/B experiments and report per-slice metrics. 5) Safety: requires at least two approved telemetry hooks and a soft holdpoint for staged rollouts; manual override supported. Checklist: - [x] Controller core + reconciler - [x] Sweep job CRD, CR controller wiring - [x] Integration with /rollout telemetry API and perf probes - [x] Canary-to-promote automation with canary snapshot creation - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Docs and playbook updates - [x] Demo script for internal testing Backwards compatibility: Existing Rollout CRs are unchanged; new fields are opt-in under rollout.spec.canarySweep. Migration: none required for current users; behavior inactive by default. Risks: sweep can increase short-term load; the controller enforces short time windows and rate limits. Rollout: gated behind feature flag rollout.canarySweep and enabled gradually for internal teams first.
